LLAMA DRAMA - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-llamadrama.txt.

A llama stands in an Andean meadow, and the hornets are coming: in lines,
waves, loops, dives, pairs and little swarms, all for the llama's nose. Turn
the long neck up and down and spit: a gob pops a hornet, which tumbles into
the grass with a bonk and stars (the big ones take three). One sting ends the
run. The more you pop, the faster and thicker they come, and the day turns to
a sunset and a starry night. Medals at 150, 450, 1000 and 3000, and your best
score is kept.

Run LlamaDrama.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  aim (the head)            Up / Down                  Up / Down arrows
  spit                      A (or B, X, Y)             X (or Z, C, V)
  start                     A (or B, X, Y, Start,      X or Enter
                            Up, Down)
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a run) Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A (or Select) on the results
  touch / mouse             click or tap the sky: the head turns there and
                            spits at once; hold and move: the head follows

Up to four llamas (cream, brown, grey and caramel) defend the meadow together,
each with their own pad and score; each is out on its own sting, the run ends
when all are out, and the results rank everyone by score, with medals.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: LlamaDrama.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in llamadrama.srm next to the exe.
